Exact feature/golden, score/mask/repeat bytes; frozen inputs/parameters/thresholds before/after.
parity.warmup_check: Every priming batch compares features byte-exact to golden; warm-up output finite/owned/strict. No extra reference calls beyond measured-batch and fixed references; warm-up not independently certified for throughput.
parity.measured_check: For every completed measured batch after t_output, compare retained features to same ordered golden bytes, retain owned score and four-mask bytes indexed by presentation, and record grouping/m plus digests. Control stalls consumer and therefore affects later latency; include its duration. After drain independently pack golden rows in exact realized FIFO grouping and call unchanged public score/strict4 once per completed batch, comparing actual score/mask bytes directly, not just hashes. No grouping is skipped, even repeats. Raw features are not retained across batches; scores/masks released after reference/post checks.
parity.coverage: Every realized grouping and shape checked; plan grouping is scheduler-dependent. No inference for unobserved groupings. Shape1..8 fixed gates are necessary but not blanket certification; B4096 science/old small windows do not certify streaming.
parity.historical_tolerances_unchanged: Same-shape score/PCA atol=rtol=1e-12 remain historical maxima; this design requires byte equality and zero decision mismatches, never enlarges tolerances. Existing arithmetic-cpu-v2 and nonfinite guards remain prerequisites.
parity.no_extra_numerical_setup: All operational numerical calls are fixed gates, priming, measured chains or measured-batch references; no additional hidden sanity/inference/reference work. Ties/ownership/error paths first covered by future data-free fixtures.
parity.independent_reference_definition: Reference separately gathers and owns golden FP32[m,8], bypasses future streaming gather/service wrapper, calls original public score once at exact same m and ordering, and independently evaluates each of four strict score>threshold comparisons (ties false), comparing direct retained score/mask bytes.
